blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Fix it without tearing out tile where we can.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Many older Evanston bathrooms have two- or three-handle valves behind original tile. Parts for some of them are still available, and a rebuild can stop the drip without touching the tile. When parts can't be found, or the valve doesn't balance pressure, we can replace it through the wall opening and cover the old holes with a trim plate. If there's an access panel behind the shower, the job is even simpler.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: Rebuilding or replacing a cartridge is usually a short visit. Older valves may need parts that take time to find. Replacing a valve behind tile costs more than one behind an access panel. A leak below may need testing to find. We diagnose first and quote a flat price.

items.q: Why does my shower turn hot when someone flushes?
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure. A new pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.q: Can you replace an old valve without retiling?
items.answer: Often. We work through the wall opening and use a trim plate to cover old holes.

items.q: Why is my shower pressure low?
items.answer: Usually scale in the showerhead or valve. Sometimes it's old supply pipe.

items.q: Is my shower leaking into the ceiling?
items.preview: We'll test the valve, drain and tile.
items.answer: We test the valve, drain and tile to find the source.

items.q: Can you replace a showerhead with a handheld?
items.answer: Yes. We can also add a slide bar or a diverter for both.

items.q: Can you install a thermostatic valve?
items.answer: Yes. It holds the temperature you set, even when other fixtures run.

items.q: Why does my shower handle feel stiff?
items.answer: Usually mineral scale on the cartridge. Replacing it makes the handle turn smoothly again.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
